title: One week into remaking my childhood dragon td game
author: 328amdev
selftext:
I played **Lair Defense Shrine and Dungeon** on my phone a decade ago. Neither runs on newer Android versions anymore, and I never found anything else with the same loop, so a week ago I started making my own version in 3D.  
  
You place fire, water and venom dragons on fixed perches along the raiders' path. Each one starts as a juvenile and evolves twice, into an adult and then an elder, and every stage has its own model. The clip shows the fire dragon going through both. Raiders are after the three eggs in your nest. Kill a carrier and the egg drops, then you have nine seconds to recover it before it's gone. Lose all three and the run is over.  
  
Almost everything is AI-generated. Codex image generation made the concept art and reference models, Tripo turned it into dragon meshes, and Claude Code writes the code and rigs the models using blender through MCP. The hardest part so far was the adult fire dragon: its first rig folded the wings back over the tail on every flap, and it took a few rounds before they beat straight up and down like a dragon's should.  
  
It's a week-old prototype with three placeholder enemy types (raider, runner, shieldbearer). This week was the core loop and the dragons. Next I'm adding more enemy types and models, and dragon mutations after that.  
  
No build yet. I'll keep posting clips as it comes together. Would love to hear your thoughts on the game.

comments.body:
Okay I love dragons so this is like, super cool! From the aesthetics and trailer only (I haven't read your description yet) -- I already want to try it! Despite not mapping out the gameplay yet! Tempo's alright too!!! So you really got the visual presentation nailed down there!!!!

Keep us updated!

comments.author: HPLovecraft1890
comments.body:
A few questions:

1) I use Claude Code (as I do a lot of non-game stuff as well), and we all know, Claude can't do image generation. Can Codex do that? Given it uses ChatGPT.  
2) Did you use any Engine? For me, Godot works like a charm, as anything can be in code. But interested in other Engines and how well they work with pure AI.

replies.author: 328amdev
replies.body: Yo! To answer, 1) Yes, I use Codex for the imagegen and concept art mostly. 2) I used Unity as the game engine but honestly with Claude/Codex being too smart now, any engine is viable.
